<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Permanently deletes the credential and releases its login name for reuse.

**Files are not deleted.** They stay in your storage and remain reachable through other
credentials with the right permissions.

The organization's default credential cannot be deleted. This cannot be undone: to stop access
while keeping the credential, deactivate it instead.
